column1: # cmake_stdlib_names — discovered-cache for cmake stdlib commands not in yc primitives.
# Used by Yc_wellform.check_unknown_command to silence false-positive "unknown
# command" warnings on legitimate cmake-stdlib calls. Without this set, a file
# would fire Unknown_command, forcing the user to either `yc_raw` or add an
#              against cmake docs at vendor/cmake when available)
# generator: hand-curated v0; cmake_name_index.exe pass deferred to v1 when
#   <source> = "<builtin>" for C-side, else a Modules/*.cmake filename
# Regen: when bumping cmake (or adding a missing name observed in a corpus
# warning), edit this file and bump the cmake-version header. The TSV is
# committed; the binary embeds names at build time via a dune rule.
# ── C-side builtins not in yc command_names ──────────────────────
